gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Commanding up top, then quietly cramped below. Funnel Display keeps every stroke the same width, while Alumni Sans SC squeezes its oversized lowercase together with stems just barely heavier than its hairlines.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anaheim: Anaheim packs its rounded, open-sided glyphs into a dense huddle that the eye slides through, lowercase filling the line like capitals. Funnel Display, with no stroke contrast at all, gives that run a cord-like counterpart.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-arsenal: Funnel Display draws its curves as heavy as its stems, like cord. Arsenal answers with a faint nib-pressure shift across each round letter and a close-knit string of tall-lowercase text, so the page gets one smooth voice and one slightly handwritten one.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-arsenal-sc: Cord-thick curves, then a lighter touch. Funnel Display is at its best when its bowls stay at stem thickness and its tips refuse to close, while Arsenal SC does its job through light but visible thick-thin variation and a wide-mouthed, tightly fitted line.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-asimovian: Asimovian reads tall and friendly, every lowercase letter built from one stroke width and standing high in the line. Asimovian would carry a long stretch smoothly, while Funnel Display above it stays spaghetti-like and loud.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-basic: Ruler-straight lines, softly handled. Basic is the pair's strongest quality in its restraint: a gentle bump from small letters to capitals beneath Funnel Display's constant-width strokes, a plain sans taking over where the heading stops shouting.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-cal-sans: Cal Sans has short ascenders and a tall x-height. Funnel Display brings spaghetti-like strokes and wide-open c tips above it, and the two share a single, unvarying line width that holds the page together.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-carlito: Modern in feel, and tightly wound. Funnel Display's marker-like line with no calligraphic modulation is the strongest quality here, set against Carlito's thread-on-a-spool spacing and its small-looking capitals beside big lowercase.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-changa: Changa's lowercase carries the stature of cast iron capitals, heavy and upright from the first line down. Funnel Display's marker-like constant line sits above it and matches that muscle.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-courier-prime: Funnel Display hits hard with spaghetti-like, same-width strokes. Courier Prime, a monospace, would settle a long page into a steady drafting-pen rhythm, its lowercase filling most of the height and its round letters opening generously.
